description: Prepare a Cigo own-store checkout link after the customer asks to buy a Carsafe filter. Ask for vehicle model/generation, model year, quantity and shipping country first. Only Korean domestic shipping is supported; do not infer country from language. Uses Korean-market fitment and verified product/variant identifiers. This tool only formats a link: it does not contact the shop, reserve stock, create an account/cart/order, or charge money. The customer checks current price, shipping, availability, login or guest checkout, consent and payment on cigo.kr. Never report a completed purchase. For HVAC, materials or overseas delivery, use an inquiry instead.
name: prepare_carsafe_purchase
title: Prepare Carsafe Purchase
